nodes.description: address public owner in Ownable; privileged role used by onlyOwner and onlyAdmin checks
address public pendingOwner in Ownable; two-step ownership handoff target
mapping(address => bool) public isAdmin in Admin; privileged role mapping
bool private _paused in Pausable; emergency-stop flag gating token transfers/mint/burn
mapping(address => uint256) private _balances in ERC20; user token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances in ERC20
uint256 private _totalSupply in ERC20
string internal _name in ERC20
string internal _symbol in ERC20
uint8 internal _decimals in ERC20
bool initialized in CWT; one-time initializer guard
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner; writes pendingOwner for two-step transfer
Ownable.acceptOwnership(); requires msg.sender == pendingOwner and promotes pendingOwner to owner
Admin.addAdmin(address newAdmin) external onlyOwner; grants privileged role
Admin.removeAdmin(address admin) external onlyOwner; revokes privileged role
CWT.initialize(string,string,uint8) public; guarded only by uninitialized bool and resets owner to msg.sender
CWT.burn(uint256) public onlyAdmin whenNotPaused; burns caller tokens
CWT.mint(address,uint256) public onlyAdmin whenNotPaused; mints tokens to arbitrary address
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256) internal virtual; updates balances using SafeMath
ERC20._mint(address,uint256) internal virtual; increases totalSupply and recipient balance
ERC20._burn(address,uint256) internal virtual; decreases balance and totalSupply
modifier onlyAdmin(); requires msg.sender == owner || isAdmin[msg.sender]
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for ownership and admin authorization
owner = msg.sender inside initialize(); unprotected initializer can seize ownership
isAdmin[newAdmin] = true / isAdmin[admin] = false; privileged role mutation
_totalSupply/_balances increase via _mint; unbounded token creation by admin
_balances/_totalSupply decrease via _burn on caller account
pendingOwner = newOwner; ownership transfer state write
_balances[sender]/_balances[recipient] arithmetic updates inside _transfer

address newAdmin parameter of addAdmin

string name parameter of initialize/constructor

uint8 decimals parameter of initialize/constructor
uint256 amount parameter of burn
